records.text: Owens presented a diagram identifying five vehicles affiliated with Turning Point USA at the UVU event: a Jeep Wagoneer, a Lincoln Navigator, two Yukon Denalis, and a Hyundai Palisade.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Let's pull up a diagram. Okay, these are the cars. On the left hand side, you see two security vehicles. The one that's in front, the first one is a black Jeep Wagoneer. We'll just call that security vehicle number one. Alex Faria is in this vehicle. ... Anyway, going back to that back to the vehicle diagram. Okay, behind that Jeep Wagoneer, you have a Lincoln Navigator. ... Now, to the right of them, we have back-to-back Yukon Denalis. You, of course, know that one of the front is going to be the one that Charlie Kirk shows up in and that Charlie Kirk is going to depart in after he is hit with an explosive. ... I'm not sure who actually drove this, but I do know based on footage, we've examined it, that it's a TPUSA vehicle, and that kind of stays parked on the far right side.
